title: KiriNoMichi(霧の道)P
description:
Enables the GUI server selector for KiriNoMichi (霧の道) on Paper servers, bridging the mist across the network.
It's the Paper Backend Plugin, to be put on every server.
body:
> **KiriNoMichi: Paper Extension**  
> _(霧の道: バックエンド拡張)_

This is the **Bukkit-side plugin** for KiriNoMichi (霧の道), the sleek cross-server teleportation and GUI selector for **Velocity networks**.

It works in sync with the **Velocity proxy plugin** to bring full GUI functionality and enhanced player interaction.

### ✦ Features:

*   📦 Handles GUI packets sent from the Velocity proxy
    
*   🏯 Opens the server selector GUI in any Paper server
    
*   🪄 Smooth teleportation visuals and optional sound effects
    
*   🔗 Plug-and-play setup – just drop it into your plugin folder
    
*   ⚡ Supports **Permission-based entries**, custom icons, and more (via config)
    

> 💡 _Requires the Velocity plugin_ to function.  
> Make sure KiriNoMichi is installed on both your Velocity proxy **and** this Paper server.
